review.title: Match review
review.analysingHint: Every position is evaluated again, so the cost of each play can be measured.

opponent.davoud.name: Davoud
opponent.davoud.blurb: Learned the rules a year ago and has not lost interest yet.
opponent.nasrin.name: Nasrin
opponent.nasrin.blurb: Hates a fight. Would rather be two pips ahead than hold an anchor.
opponent.keyvan.name: Keyvan
opponent.keyvan.blurb: Learned in a coffee house. Hits first and counts afterwards.
opponent.mehrdad.name: Mehrdad
opponent.mehrdad.blurb: Patient to a fault. Will build a wall and wait behind it all evening.
opponent.parvaneh.name: Parvaneh
opponent.parvaneh.blurb: Happy to be behind. Holds two points in your home board and waits.
opponent.ostad.name: Ostad
opponent.ostad.blurb: No style at all. Only the best move, every time.
review.prAxisHint: Lower PR is better, so the axis is inverted — the line rising means you are improving.
